mentions.name: Surraura
mentions.description: This macOS app wraps whatever audio is playing through device convolution (e.g., old radio, hi-fi system), room convolution (e.g., bedroom, forest), ambience layers (rain, wind, waves), and Apple spatial processing so the sound feels like a real space. It is built to help with focus for late-diagnosed ADHD, since hearing sound in a space helps more than dry audio.
mentions.problem: Late-diagnosed ADHD; dry audio doesn't help focus, but hearing sound rendered in a real-feeling space does.
mentions.audience: The author's own personal use for late-diagnosed ADHD
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on an app to help my late diagnosed ADHD - through sound.

The app wraps whatever is playing on mac through device convolution (old radio, hifi system) - Room convolution (a bedroom, a forest) and adds ambience (rain, wind, waves) and Apples spatial processing - so it sounds like a real space.
mentions.author: jahala
